name: Fourth Fish Rozelle
reviews: Loved my experience at Fourth Fish! The food was fresh, delicious, and really well made. The staff were friendly and the place had a nice, relaxed vibe. Definitely recommend it for a good seafood meal.
Normally my favourite but tonight was disappointing.  Service slow but food (fish) was overcooked amd orders got mixed up.  We left hungry not able to eat over dressed salad and fish.

Fourth Fish used to be the go to for wonderful quality fish and chips. Have they changed hands as today’s meal may be the last one from them . The battered fish existed of a piece of paper thin dry fish coated in an overcooked batter that tasted of stale oil and left a very unpleasant aftertaste.
Such a massive disappointment and I’d love to say it was a one off but this is the second time that the meal had quite seriously dropped in quality. Not prepared to experience this disappointment a third time .
Sorry .

Changed ownership, used to be great but now terrible. Food is greasy and overcooked. They can’t get orders out on time so there is a permanent herd of Uber Eats delivery riders outside the door. Feels chaotic and frankly I no longer trust them. Real shame.
Taste of barramundi was fresh & authentic. Combination of chips with coleslaw was amazing. I'll definitely come again.
